notes.title: Balance and bug-fix patch
notes.content: [h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed rank change animation displaying negative instead of positive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Hull Support Beam description missing percentage sign[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ions not removing electricity from enemy ships[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Buzz Saw applying rust effect too many times[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Shipping Pallet now grants hull instead of only max hull[/p][/*][*][p]Flight Deck radar gain: 2 → 1[/p][/*][*][p]Synthesizer hull cost: 4 → 3[/p][/*][*][p]Spike Factory armor gain: 5 → 6[/p][/*][*][p]Spikes percentage damage: 3% → 5%[/p][/*][*][p]Blaster Cannon cost: 3 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Slug Cannon cost: 3 → 4[/p][/*][*][p]Buzz Saw rust chance: 20% → 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Medic hull restore: 6% → 8%[/p][/*][*][p]Titan Core hull gain: 4% → 5%[/p][/*][*][p]Ion Rifle charge speed: 7% → 8%[/p][/*][*][p]Galvanized Plate armor gain: 5 → 8[/p][/*][*][p]Reactive Plating chance: 40% → 50%[/p][/*][/list]
